_: Twenty frames of Dill on the homepage. For each piece: sketch is the drawn frame, img is the scan of the paper cut (put it in images/twenty/), link is its own Stripe payment link capped at one sale, sold turns true when it goes. sketch only = shown, not for sale. img and link = for sale. The loop at the top plays all twenty at fps frames a second, using the paper cut where there is one and the sketch where there is not.

pieces.alt: Dill no. 01: the top of a blue paper head with lilac eyebrows, peering up over the bottom edge, on green paper
Dill no. 02: a blue paper face risen to the nose, wide eyes, lilac eyebrows, a pink nose and two front teeth at the bottom edge, on green paper
Dill no. 03: the whole blue paper face up from the bottom edge, head tipped to one side, mouth open on two front teeth, on olive paper
Dill no. 04: the face tilted further, both ears showing, mouth open on two front teeth, a brown paper shoulder at the corner
Dill no. 05: the face close and tilted, eyes wide, mouth open with a pink tongue, a brown paper shoulder at the corner
Dill no. 06: the face filling the frame, tilted, eyes wide, mouth open with a pink tongue
Dill no. 07: the face tilted and pulling back, one ear up, a small open mouth
Dill no. 08: the face sliding off to the lower left, one big eye and an ear, a brown paper shoulder at the corner
Dill no. 09: the face sinking off the lower left corner, one eye and one ear left showing
Dill no. 10: the face nearly gone off the lower left corner, one eye and one ear, mostly green paper
Dill no. 11: the top of the head rising again at the bottom edge, two eyes just showing between blue paper fingers
Dill no. 12: the face up to the mouth, two front teeth showing, blue paper hands at the bottom edge
Dill no. 13: the face turned and looking back over a shoulder, a hand at the lower left, small open mouth
Dill no. 14: the whole round face, chin up, both ears out, a small open mouth with two teeth
Dill no. 15: the face tipped back, chin and neck showing, mouth nearly closed, a brown paper shoulder below
Dill no. 16: the face tipped far back, neck stretched, one eye at the top edge
Dill no. 17: the face tipped to one side, brows down, mouth closed to a small point
Dill no. 18: the face tilted, calmer, mouth a little open, a brown paper shoulder at the corner
Dill no. 19: the face tilted, mouth open on two front teeth, a brown paper shoulder at the corner
Dill no. 20: the face level and looking straight out, both ears, mouth open on two front teeth
